def factor_overnight_breakout_align_gate(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=60)
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_change = df_copy["volume"].pct_change()
    agree = np.sign(ret) == np.sign(vol_change)
    alignment = agree.rolling(10, min_periods=5).mean()
    gate = 0.5 + 0.5 * alignment
    signal = overnight_ret * vol_ratio * gate
    df_copy["factor_overnight_breakout_align_gate"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_breakout_align_gate"]
description: Crossover: primary parent mechanism of overnight return multiplied by volume ratio to confirm breakouts (high IC/ICIR). Borrows lightweight return-volume sign alignment gate from secondary parent as a continuous attenuation factor. When price and volume changes are consistently aligned, signal is amplified; when they diverge, signal is dampened. This aims to improve RankIC/IR by reducing noise during misalignment periods while preserving IC/ICIR. Parent strength target: IC and ICIR.
